rca_of_issue: Unexpected-text-node warning: React-Native-Web enforces that children of <View> must be a component or wrapped <Text>. When a JSX expression like `{condition && ' '}` evaluates to a bare string or when JSX contains whitespace between tags on separate lines inside a Fragment inside a View, RNW raises this warning. In this pick's render tree only Intelligence2.tsx (clean) and HistoricalIntelligence.tsx (822 lines) are involved after the header — the culprit is almost certainly in HistoricalIntelligence.tsx or one of its downstream helpers. Reproduction: login demo@lockscore.ai / demo123, navigate to /pick/bf444687-aaaf-53c1-999b-2de98aaee82e — the toast 'Unexpected text node:       . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' appears at the bottom of the screen within ~3s. Mitigation: locate raw string/whitespace children (`grep -n "^\s*' '" HistoricalIntelligence.tsx`, review conditional renders emitting bare strings), wrap in <Text> or convert to null.
